items.title: htmLawed - Moderately critical - Cross-site scripting - SA-CONTRIB-2026-315
items.summary:
Project: 
htmLawed
Project machine name: 
htmlawed
Date: 
2026-November-04
Security risk: 
Moderately critical 14 ∕ 25 AC:Basic/A:User/CI:Some/II:Some/E:Theoretical/TD:All
Vulnerability: 
Cross-site scripting
Affected versions: 
>=4.1.0 <4.1.11
CVE IDs: 
CVE-2026-122079
Description: 

The htmLawed module enables use of the htmLawed PHP library as a filter in a Text Format for restriction/filtering of HTML in textual input.

The htmLawed filter does not sufficiently filter attributes, leading to a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.

This vulnerability affects sites on Drupal core > 11.2 or any version of core with the HTMX library.

Solution: 

Install the latest version:

  • If you use version 4.1.x, upgrade to 4.1.11.
  • 8.x-3.x versions are not affected.

Review configuration and update:

  • For Text Formats that use the htmLawed filter, check that the filter's Config. setting includes data-hx-* for the deny_attribute parameter. E.g.: 'safe'=>1, 'elements'=>'a, em, strong, cite, code, ol, ul, li, dl, dt, dd', 'deny_attribute'=>'data-hx-*, id, style'

Security risk: 
Moderately critical 11 ∕ 25 AC:Complex/A:User/CI:Some/II:Some/E:Theoretical/TD:Uncommon
Vulnerability: 
Cross-site scripting
Affected versions: 
>=3.0.0 <3.9.0 || >=4.0.0 <4.1.8
CVE IDs: 
CVE-2026-122080
Description: 

The htmLawed module enables use of the htmLawed PHP library as a filter in a Text Format for restriction/filtering of HTML in textual input.

The module's filtering of malicious HTML can be bypassed by using a malformed UTF8 character, leading to a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.

Only sites using an SQLite database are affected with versions of the htmLawed library prior to 1.2.17.

Solution: 

Install the latest version:

  • If you use version 4.1.x, upgrade to 4.1.11 (was fixed in 4.1.8).
  • If you use version 8.x-3.x, upgrade to 8.x-3.10 (was fixed in 8.x-3.9).

Alternately, replace the htmLawed.php and htmLawed_README.htm files in the module directory with new downloads for htmLawed library version >= 1.2.17.

items.title: Islandora  - Moderately critical - Access bypass leading to arbitrary file overwrite - SA-CONTRIB-2026-313
items.summary:
Project: 
Islandora
Project machine name: 
islandora
Date: 
2026-November-04
Security risk: 
Moderately critical 10 ∕ 25 AC:Basic/A:User/CI:None/II:Some/E:Theoretical/TD:Default
Vulnerability: 
Access bypass leading to arbitrary file overwrite
Affected versions: 
<2.19.1
CVE IDs: 
CVE-2026-122081
Description: 

Islandora does not sufficiently check file update access when processing media source and derivative uploads. A user with permission to update media or create derivatives can submit a crafted request to overwrite files they are not authorized to modify, including private files.

The Islandora Text Extraction submodule also bypasses shared destination URI and file extension validation when attaching OCR output.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must have permission to update media or to update a node and create media.

Solution: 

Install the latest version:

  • Upgrade to Islandora 2.19.1.

  • Whippet (VenusTech ADLab) (whippet)

Description: 

The Mime Mail module gives Drupal sites the ability to send HTML email messages.

Under rare site configuration conditions, a user with the ability to send HTML emails could send non-public data that had been uploaded to the files directory,

This vulnerability is mitigated by the fact the attacker would need advance knowledge of uploaded files, and to send HTML emails and set the recipient list.

Solution:

items.title: WordsOnline Connector - Moderately critical - SQL injection - SA-CONTRIB-2026-310
items.summary:

Project machine name:

Date:

Security risk: 
Moderately critical 12 ∕ 25 AC:Basic/A:Admin/CI:All/II:None/E:Theoretical/TD:All
Vulnerability: 
SQL injection
Affected versions: 
>=2.0.0 <2.0.6
CVE IDs: 
CVE-2026-122084
Description: 

The WordsOnline Connector module integrates Drupal with the WordsOnline translation service through the TMGMT module.

The module doesn't properly validate data, resulting in an SQL Injection vulnerability. An attacker can use this to read data from the Drupal database, including user account data.

The vulnerability is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must be logged in and hold the Create translation jobs permission provided by TMGMT.

Solution: 

Install the latest version:

  • Upgrade to WordsOnline Connector 2.0.6.
  • 1.0.x is not affected.

Vulnerability: 
Access bypass
Affected versions: 
<2.0.3
CVE IDs: 
CVE-2026-122076
Description: 

This module provides a separate page with a form for users to change their own password, which asks for the current password before accepting a new one.

The module doesn't sufficiently verify the current password in some cases.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must already have access to the victim's authenticated session (for example an unattended browser or a stolen session cookie). It allows that temporary session access to be turned into a persistent account takeover.

Solution: 

Install the latest version:

  • If you use version 2.0.x, upgrade to Password Separate Form 2.0.3.

items.title: Scheduler - Moderately critical - Access bypass - SA-CONTRIB-2026-306
items.summary:
Project: 
Scheduler
Project machine name: 
scheduler
Date: 
2026-November-04
Security risk: 
Moderately critical 13 ∕ 25 AC:Basic/A:User/CI:Some/II:Some/E:Theoretical/TD:Default
Vulnerability: 
Access bypass
Affected versions: 
<1.7.0 || >=2.2.0 <2.2.3 || 2.0.* || 2.1.* || >= 2.3.0 <2.3.1
CVE IDs: 
CVE-2026-122075
Description: 

This module enables you to schedule content to be published or unpublished at a certain time in the future.

The module doesn't sufficiently check if a user has permission to change publication or unpublication dates. This might cause certain information to be publicly disclosed ahead of the scheduled time, or content to become inaccessible earlier or later than planned.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must already have permission to edit the affected content, and the content must be editable through a web services API like JSON:API or REST.

Solution: 

Install the latest version:

  • If you use version 8.x-1.x, upgrade to Scheduler 8.x-1.7.
  • If you use version 2.2.x, upgrade to Scheduler 2.2.3.
  • If you use version 2.3.x, upgrade to Scheduler 2.3.1.
  • Version 2.1.x branch is no longer supported. Sites on this version should update to 2.2.3 or 2.3.1.
